scores.notes: Oil-style scene of an anonymous grey-bearded elder gesturing as if reciting, rolled scrolls on the bench beside him, an extended family lined up behind and a Roman soldier at right; the prominent reciting elder reads as a narrator/record-keeper the title verse does not call for and none of the named persons (Jesus, David, Abraham) is identifiable. Scrolls are blank, edges fully painted, hands fine. Moderate confidence on the narrator call.

Night scene: Peter strides across the waves from the boat toward Jesus standing on the water at right, other disciples watching from the boat under a lantern. No lettering, edges fully painted, anatomy fine.

Holmes holds the blue stone up to the window light while Watson sits with hat and bag by the fire; matches the moment. Papers are blank and the mantel clock dial is only a faint smudge, so I did not count lettering; Holmes is a generic gaunt dark-haired figure, not a clear actor likeness.

A teacher in ochre tunic and blue cloak (scrolls at his belt) addresses a gathered household around a brazier in a stone room; I read the speaker addressing 'we' as the moment of the epistle's direct address, not an extra narrator. No lettering, hands fine, edges painted.

Alice stands on the wood path looking up at the grinning striped Cat on a bough, claws and teeth showing, tail dissolving in a swirl; matches the moment. No lettering, paint runs to all edges, anatomy fine.

Fiery throne with burning wheels, fiery stream, ring of placed thrones, bowing attendants and Daniel watching at left all fit, but on the central throne seat a robe-like drapery falls over a lap/knee form with a tall white-cored blaze where torso and head would be, which reads as a robed seated presence (borderline, moderate confidence). No face or limbs drawn, so I left rule_violation no; bare-paper cloud and smoke reach the top and right edges (accepted).

Cat's head alone floats in the air while Alice talks to it with her flamingo beside her on the croquet ground; scene fits. Lettering: the bent playing-card arches at left show suit pips, court-card pictures and a legible '5' index beside a spade (plus a K-like corner index), small but a real numeral.

Daniel in blue cloak gestures as he answers the enthroned king amid courtiers and banquet tables; scene fits. Lettering: the blue glazed-brick wall behind carries bands of glyph-like marks (a row of C/O ring letters, wedge rows and a lower-left band of letter-like characters), none readable. Edges painted, anatomy fine.

Watson holds the small printed slip up to read while Holmes speaks across a table of letters; scene fits. Lettering: script lines on the slip, gibberish block headlines on the newspapers on Watson's lap and at right, a pseudo-script bottle label lower right and the mantel clock dial; no legible word. Holmes is generic, hands fine.

Robed many-winged seraphim hover in a smoke-filled temple above kneeling Isaiah; no throne or figure for God is drawn. Details drift from the text (faces covered with hands, feet left bare, one seraph already holds tongs with a coal) but subject and place are right; small patches of bare cream paper at the right/top edge (accepted). No lettering.

Giant Alice tips the jury-box and the animal jurors spill out with their slates while the King points from the dais; scene fits. Anatomy: the falling Lizard juror at centre (green tail and legs, head-down) has a badger-striped black-and-white head, a hybrid face. Lettering: heart pips on the card soldiers at lower right only; slates and papers are blank.

Inside the blaze of light at top centre is a faint human-shaped figure of light: round head with a halo-like ring, shoulders, outstretched arms from which the fire streams run, and a long body; that gives the Ancient of Days a human form and breaks the no-human-body rule. Daniel watches below beside two empty stone thrones with braziers (not flaming or wheeled) and a white-robed multitude. No lettering, edges painted.
Peter in the foreground with net and staff turns back as the bound Jesus looks at him from among soldiers in the courtyard by a brazier; matches the moment. No lettering, edges painted, anatomy fine.

Lestrade half-risen and leaning in, Holmes studying the paper, Watson behind; scene fits. Lettering: squiggle pencil lines on the note Holmes holds, pseudo-script on papers on the side table at right, and tick marks on the clock face at upper left; none readable. A thin pale unpainted sliver runs along the left/right edges (accepted). Holmes is generic, not a clear actor likeness.

David kneels at the brook with staff, shepherd's pouch of stones and sling, a tiny distant figure beyond; matches the moment. The wash fades to bare white paper along the top and all corners (accepted). No lettering, anatomy fine.

A speaker addresses seated listeners beside a large dim metal mirror on a stand with a city behind; the mirror carries the verse's image and I read the speaker addressing 'we' as the moment of the letter rather than an extra narrator. No lettering, hands fine, edges painted.

Hatherley with bandaged hand points excitedly at the burning house, Holmes beside him, crowd, fire-engines, gravel drive and rose-bushes; matches the moment. Loose wash leaves bare paper at the bottom-left corner (accepted). No lettering; Holmes is generic.
Jesus stands before the open rock tomb calling toward it with a crowd looking on and a walled city behind; matches the moment. No lettering, edges painted, anatomy fine.

Watson at the door with bag and hat being pulled in by Holmes while the stout red-haired Wilson half rises from his chair; scene fits. Lettering: a blackletter-style gibberish masthead on the stack of newspapers at bottom left, pseudo-script on pinned papers and a clock dial; no legible word. Holmes is generic, hands fine.
A column of cloud rests over the tabernacle in the middle of the Israelite camp with people at their tents; matches the verse and God is shown only as cloud. No lettering, edges painted.

A weary man walks a high ledge, but the picture splits at the arch's left pillar into two contradictory views: the left half is a distant aerial view of a walled hill-city with its temple, the right half a close street-level view through a giant arch of a second temple fortress with townspeople at nearly his scale; the same city appears twice at conflicting scale. Sky fades to bare paper at top left (accepted). No lettering.

A great whirlwind towers over Job kneeling at the ash heap with his three friends; God is shown only as storm, no figure. Bare paper gaps at the left and right edges (accepted). No lettering, anatomy fine.

Fire and burning sulfur streak from the sky onto two burning cities on the plain, a dropped staff and waterskin in the foreground and three tiny fleeing figures; matches the verse with no figure for God. No lettering, edges painted.

Lestrade leans over the desk as Holmes examines the paper with a magnifier; scene fits. Lettering: block-capital gibberish headlines on newspapers on the desk and floor ('LEER BAVIE'-like strings), a heading on Holmes's slip and a clock dial at right; letter-like but no legible word. Holmes is generic, hands fine.

Daniel, unharmed, is hauled up out of the stone pit on ropes by three men while the king reaches gladly toward him with courtiers behind; matches the moment. No lettering, edges painted, hands and feet fine.
Fire rains from a dark sky onto two burning cities with smoke over the plain and small figures on the roads; matches the verse with no figure for God. No lettering, edges painted.
Moses sits on a stone with Aaron and Hur each holding up one of his arms while the battle rages below; matches the moment. Hands and gripping fingers check out on zoom; no lettering, edges painted.

The father with open arms and a ring on his hand faces the ragged barefoot son while two servants bring the robe and sandals; matches the moment. Pale sky leaves patches of bare paper along the top edge (accepted). No lettering, hands fine.

The Mock Turtle (calf's head, shell, flippers) and the Gryphon dance on the shingle on either side of Alice by the sea; matches the moment and both are drawn as animals. Bare paper patches along the top/right edges (accepted). No lettering, anatomy fine.

A ragged, weary man walks through a city gate under descending rays of light among townspeople with the temple city behind; a fair reading of strength given to the weak, with God shown only as light. No lettering, edges painted, anatomy fine.

Egyptian chariots and horsemen gallop between the walls of water, but they ride toward the viewer with the robed Israelite crowd and a Moses-like staff figure behind them on the far side, so the pursuers are running away from the people they pursue; positions contradict the pursuit. No figure for God, no lettering, edges painted, horses and riders fine.

Hatter, March Hare and sleeping Dormouse at the long tea table under a tree with Alice sitting thinking at the end; matches the silent pause. No lettering (no card in the hat), edges painted, hands fine; Hatter is not a film likeness.

The disciples stand on the shore looking at a fire of coals with fish and a loaf on it, boat and net behind; matches the moment. Sky and foreground fade to bare white paper at the top and corners (accepted). No lettering, anatomy fine.

The whole picture is an elderly author writing on a scroll at a lamp-lit table (other figures in the background): an author/narrator figure the title verse does not call for, with none of the named persons shown. Lettering: rows of dash-and-dot pseudo-script on the open scroll at centre, unreadable. Edges painted, hands fine.
Jesus points into the dark open tomb with the round stone rolled aside and a crowd watching at left; matches the moment. No lettering, edges painted, anatomy fine.

Peter steps down from the boat onto the water toward Jesus standing on the waves at right, disciples watching from the boat; matches the moment. Feet and hands check out on zoom; no lettering, edges painted.

The King points at the Cat's floating head beside Alice with her flamingo while the Queen shouts in the distance on the croquet ground; scene fits. Lettering: suit pips on the card arches and card soldiers and a court-card picture at far left, no corner indices or words. The Queen's black hair, tall white collar and heart gown lean toward familiar screen imagery but are not a clear copy, so rule_violation no.

The man kneels with a knife over his dead concubine lying intact on a mat inside the house, the donkey outside in moonlight; the act is implied without gore (only a tiny dark sliver at the knife tip). No lettering, edges painted, hands fine.

Holmes thumps the pavement with his stick outside the corner pawnbroker's with three gilt balls, Watson beside him and the assistant visible through the door glass, railed enclosure at right; matches the moment. The brown name board is blank, so no lettering; wash fades to bare paper at the left, right and bottom edges (accepted).

The Israelites with Moses and his staff walk the sea-bed path between towering walls of water on both sides; matches the verse with no figure for God. A few at left wade in shallow water, a minor detail; no lettering, edges painted, anatomy fine.

Goliath pitches forward with a small wound on his forehead while David follows through with the sling, armies behind; matches the moment and the injury is not lingered on. David also holds a spare loop of cord in his other hand, a minor oddity; sky fades to bare white paper at the top and sides (accepted). No lettering.
